حككت (form I)
# حَكَكْتُ (ḥakaktu) /ħa.kak.tu/: first-person singular past active of حَكَّ (ḥakka)
# حَكَكْتَ (ḥakakta) /ħa.kak.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of حَكَّ (ḥakka)
# حَكَكْتِ (ḥakakti) /ħa.kak.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of حَكَّ (ḥakka)
# حُكِكْتُ (ḥukiktu) /ħu.kik.tu/: first-person singular past passive of حَكَّ (ḥakka)
# حُكِكْتَ (ḥukikta) /ħu
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
